e.body:
European Actuarial Journal（EAJ，Springer，`link.springer.com/journal/13385`）是**欧洲精算学界的研究期刊**。可核实信息：**印刷 ISSN 2190-9733 / 电子 ISSN 2190-9741**；**Journal Impact Factor 1.7（2025）**、五年影响因子 1.6（2025）；**投稿到首次决定中位数 15 天**；出版模式为 **Hybrid**（混合开放获取，即部分文章开放获取、其余需订阅）；宗旨聚焦「保险及相关金融风险的研究、建模与管理，以随机模型为核心」。近期开放获取文章示例：*The actuarial origins of survival models*（Stephen J. Richards，2026-09-05）。

对 RIAA：EAJ 的定位介于「纯方法论」与「职业实践」之间，且**明确以欧洲监管环境为背景**——这与本 wiki 的欧洲条目正好成套：行业联合会立场见 [[insurance-europe]]，监管统计见 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]，全球智库口径见 [[geneva-association]]；方法论上它与 [[astin-bulletin]]（非寿险方法论）互补，主题覆盖可对照池内 [[resurv]]（准备金）、[[openirm]]（开放内部模型）一类条目。**15 天初审中位数**这个数字对考虑投稿的学生也有参考价值。文献检索入口见 [[repec-g22]]。适合作文献综述、欧洲方向研究与投稿参考。**核实说明**：期刊主页 HTTP 200（234KB）实测，未核实文章全文。
e.body_en:
The European Actuarial Journal (EAJ, Springer, `link.springer.com/journal/13385`) is **the European actuarial community’s research journal**. Verifiable details: **print ISSN 2190-9733 / electronic ISSN 2190-9741**; **Journal Impact Factor 1.7 (2025)** and five-year IF 1.6 (2025); **median submission-to-first-decision of 15 days**; **Hybrid** publishing model (some articles open access, the rest by subscription); its aims and scope centre on "the study, modelling and managing of insurance and related financial risks", with stochastic models at the core. A recent open-access example: *The actuarial origins of survival models* (Stephen J. Richards, 2026-09-05).

For RIAA: EAJ sits between "pure methodology" and "professional practice" and is **explicitly framed against the European regulatory environment** — which pairs neatly with this wiki’s European entries: the industry federation’s positions in [[insurance-europe]], supervisory statistics in [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], and the global think-tank view in [[geneva-association]]; methodologically it complements [[astin-bulletin]] (non-life methodology), and its topical range can be compared with corpus entries such as [[resurv]] (reserving) and [[openirm]] (open internal models). The **15-day median first decision** is also a useful data point for students considering where to submit. For literature searching see [[repec-g22]]. Suits literature reviews, European-focused research and submission choices. **Verification note**: the journal home page was measured at HTTP 200 (234KB); article full texts were not verified.

European Actuarial Journal（EAJ，Springer，`link.springer.com/journal/13385`）是**歐洲精算學界的研究期刊**。可核實資訊：**印刷 ISSN 2190-9733 / 電子 ISSN 2190-9741**；**Journal Impact Factor 1.7（2025）**、五年影響因子 1.6（2025）；**投稿到首次決定中位數 15 天**；出版模式為 **Hybrid**；宗旨聚焦「保險及相關金融風險的研究、建模與管理，以隨機模型為核心」。近期開放獲取文章示例：*The actuarial origins of survival models*（2026-09-05）。

對 RIAA：EAJ 的定位介於「純方法論」與「職業實踐」之間，且**明確以歐洲監管環境為背景**——與本 wiki 的歐洲條目正好成套：[[insurance-europe]]、[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[geneva-association]]；方法論上與 [[astin-bulletin]] 互補，主題覆蓋可對照 [[resurv]]、[[openirm]]。**15 天初審中位數**對考慮投稿的學生也有參考價值。文獻檢索入口見 [[repec-g22]]。適合作文獻綜述、歐洲方向研究與投稿參考。**核實說明**：期刊主頁 HTTP 200 實測，未核實文章全文。
